text:
maria: Quick sync — planning to push Release Train wave-14 today. Window 18:00-18:30 UTC. Target services: inference-api, router, telemetry. Need canary owners + rollback lead.

devin: I can take inference-api canary at ~18:05. will run smoke and hang for 10m. :thumbsup:

ash: tagging @devin — add the `lite-quant` variant for the canary so we test quantized path.

devin: noted. will deploy `inference-api:v3.2.1-lite-quant` -> monitor.

ash: also confirm KV cache warmup step after deploy.

maria: canary checklist (brief):
1) smoke script `/ops/smoke/run inference-api --sample 50`
2) check /health and 95th p50 latency (<120ms)
3) confirm KV cache hit rate > 60% after warmup
4) if error spike or latency x2, rollback immediately.

leo: I'll take router at 18:12. small change, but I can validate routing table rollout.

sara: I'll own telemetry rollout at 18:20 and validate metrics pipeline + traces.

devin: smoke run started at 18:06 (ops-bot triggered). ops-bot: `smoke/inference-api run 50 samples`

ops-bot: smoke result: PASS (50/50) — avg latency 98ms — 95p 112ms — errors 0.

devin: pushing to canary fleet now (command: `make deploy CANARY=true SERVICE=inference-api TAG=v3.2.1-lite-quant`).

ops-bot: deploy event: inference-api v3.2.1-lite-quant -> canary pool. task_id=dtk-8891

maria: reminder: rollback image is `inference-api:v3.2.0-stable`. rollback steps are in runbook: `/playbooks/release/train-rollbacks.md` (follow 2-step rollback: switch routing -> drain -> revert image).

leo: router canary looks good, rate-limited to 5% traffic. no error bump.

sara: telemetry shows normal ingestion, sampling at expected rate. traces linked.

devin: after 10m canary window and no regressions, I'll promote to wave. calling it at 18:16 if green.

maria: sounds good. final check: are backups/snapshots good? ops-bot: volume-snapshot status.

ops-bot: snapshot check: control-plane snapshots present, last taken 17:50 UTC, size 1.8GB.

ash: quick note — if we see mem growth on inference-api workers, run `kubectl rollout undo` then scale down replicas to 0 -> 2 to drain hot caches. documented in playbook.

devin: promo started at 18:17. monitoring for 5m. will ping here on completion.

ops-bot: promotion event: inference-api promoted to wave fleet.

devin: promo complete at 18:22. metrics look stable. rolling to 100% per policy.

maria: thanks all. post-deploy tasks: update release tracker, annotate any follow-ups, and file a short blip if anything odd.

leo: note — will leave a short postmortem if we see any anomalies. otherwise :party-parrot:

sara: all good from telemetry, closing handoff.

maria: closing thread. next wave scheduled Tue 18:00 UTC.
